newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firmer in choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firmer in choppy trade.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended firmer on Thursday in choppy trading.
"The market was a bit wild today but the index closed higher after some profit taking earlier," said a dealer with a Japanese brokerage.
He said a stronger dollar/yen rate after the release of a smaller-than-expected Japanese trade surplus in June also boosted the stock index.
The September index settled at 20,595, up some 160 points from its previous close. Volume was 16,140 contracts.

Dealers said traders continued to buy the Nikkei contract on SIMEX after the market close in Osaka. "It was firming towards the close and the buying just continued in SIMEX so that it closed about 40 points higher," one dealer said.
Dealers said sentiment for Japanese stocks should remained underpined in the near term as some funds flow back to Japan from weak regional Asian stock markets.
The Nikkei futures is seen testing higher first at 20,850 and subsequently 21,000. Downside support is seen at 20,210.
Taiwan futures traded on SIMEX continued to trade actively after the Taiwan cash stock index touched a seven-year intraday high in record volume.
The Taiwan MSCI July contract settled at 412.7, up 6.4 on volume of 1,953 contracts.
